channelTitle: Bloated after a big meal? Grandma's peppermint tea
hook: Feeling bloated after a big meal? Grandma always had a peppermint tea bag ready for this.
remedy: A warm cup of peppermint tea is an old-fashioned after-dinner ritual many families swear by for easing a bloated, heavy feeling after eating.
steps: Steep a peppermint tea bag (or fresh mint leaves) in hot water for 5 to 7 minutes
Let it cool slightly so it's warm, not scalding
Sip slowly about 20 minutes after your meal
caution: Skip it if you have acid reflux or a hiatal hernia — peppermint can sometimes make heartburn worse.
cta: Follow along for more old-school home remedies
